description: Reports the live contract of the Mastering engine (GET /mastering/capabilities): for each of the eight modules the unit, range, step, neutral and initial value, the loudness targets, the built-in presets (builtin:balanced, ... with their full settings, a good starting point for a new preset), the limits (200 MB, 10 minutes, 50 presets of 60 characters), the validation tolerance, whether THIS account may render through the API (`renderAllowed`: any account with mastering:write) and the render quota balance. Call it before jj_create_mastering_preset or jj_master_audio with inline settings. Needs no scope and costs nothing.
name: jj_mastering_capabilities
title: Mastering: limits, setting ranges, targets and render quota
